description: Queuing reminder emails for meetings starting soon.
precondition: Meetings about to start; clock replaced.

preconditions: No Published meeting starts within the next 15 minutes.
cases.return: 0; nothing saved.

preconditions: Published in-person meeting "Họp giao ban" starts at 03:10Z; organizer An (an@example.vn); participants Bình (Chair) and Cường (Member); invitations were sent days ago.
cases.return: 2 (one reminder per participant).
cases.log: Two EmailMessage rows queued, subject "Cuộc họp sắp bắt đầu: Họp giao ban", deduplication key "email-starting-soon:<meetingId>:<start unix seconds>:<participant id>"; the text names the start time, place and the link https://tc.example.vn/mgmt/meetings/<meetingId>; the HTML shows the role (Chủ toạ / Thành viên), the chair and the organizer contact "An (an@example.vn)"; one commit.

preconditions: An online meeting held in the TrustCabinet room (Mode Online, no external link).
cases.return: The button and the link point to /mgmt/meetings/<meetingId>/room, labelled "Vào phòng họp".

preconditions: An online meeting with an external link, or a hybrid meeting with an external link.
cases.return: The button is "Xem cuộc họp" pointing to /mgmt/meetings/<meetingId>.

preconditions: A hybrid meeting with no external link.
cases.return: The button is "Vào phòng họp" (a meeting that is not in person and has no link is entered from the app).

preconditions: Participant Bình was invited at 02:59Z, inside the 15-minute window before the 03:10Z start.
cases.return: No email for Bình; the other participants still get theirs.

preconditions: Participant invited exactly at 02:55Z, which is 15 minutes before a 03:10Z start.
cases.return: No email: an invitation created at the boundary counts as late.

preconditions: Participant invited at 02:54:59Z, one second before the boundary.
cases.return: An email is queued.

preconditions: All reminder keys for this meeting and start time are already stored.
cases.return: 0; nothing saved.

preconditions: The meeting was reminded for 03:10Z, then rescheduled to 03:12Z; the new key holds the new start.
cases.return: One email per participant for the new time.

preconditions: The same email key is produced twice in one run (two reads of the same participant).
cases.return: Only one email is queued for that key.

preconditions: A Guest invitation on the meeting; the link provider prepares the link https://tc.example.vn/guest/verify?t=abc.
cases.return: An email to the Guest: button "Xác minh email để vào cuộc họp" with that link; no place and no role; the contact is the organizer's name only.

preconditions: A Guest invitation; the link provider returns Unavailable.
cases.return: No email for the Guest and the key is not recorded, so the next cycle tries again; participants are unaffected.

preconditions: A Guest invitation; the link provider returns Invalid.
cases.return: No email for the Guest.

preconditions: A Guest invited at 02:59Z (inside the window).
cases.return: No email for the Guest and the link provider is not asked.

preconditions: A Guest whose reminder key was already stored.
cases.return: No email; the link provider is not asked.

preconditions: Two meetings start within the window, each with 2 participants.
The meeting has no active Chair.
cases.return: Reminders are still queued; the HTML has no "Chủ toạ" row.

preconditions: The meeting title contains a line break and is 320 characters long.
cases.return: The subject has the line break replaced by a space and is at most 300 characters.

preconditions: The subject's 300th character would split a surrogate pair.
cases.return: The subject is cut to 299 characters.

preconditions: Only deduplicated work: every recipient is skipped.
cases.return: 0; no save is made when nothing was queued.
